senses.en: Come to plant various vegetables and fruits.
I don't want to go. I'm not going.

records.text: ini padauxen inusat ni kalagu ki atun

senses.zh: Kalagu 沒有叫 Atun 喝酒
senses.en: Kalagu didn't make Atun drink wine.

records.text: ini pinatalekan naki a maxiasu ki rumut ni taupungu

senses.zh: 老闆沒有叫我媳婦煮肉
senses.en: The boss did not make my daughter-in-law cook meat.

records.text: itih ka mikadeng ka ini mupuzah

senses.en: Because Itih was sick, she didn't come.
enemy (lit. ‘the ones who are not good with each other’)
